purpose: Resume-first exact HPADJ20 replay with durable one-row checkpoints and strict Stage32 concurrency headroom.

partition.assignment: Source-locked deterministic greedy FULL178-row partition with shard_count=178; therefore every unit contains exactly one row.
partition.expected_coverage: FULL178 row indices 0..177 exactly once; every historical b-interval cell belonging to each row is computed inside that row unit.
partition.finest_practical_boundary_rationale: The locked worker already exposes one exact FULL178 row as an independently verifiable unit. Splitting below a row would require a new execution worker and repeat the expensive global H=96 profile/context initialization across each row's historical b-interval cells. A near-maximum d=190 one-row unit has already completed successfully, so one row is the current finest practical exact boundary without changing mathematical semantics.

representative_measurement.note: This is a successfully completed near-maximum-d FULL178 row from the cancelled generation-3 run, measured before the replacement scale-out.

carry_over.chain_model: Each generation first validates the previous run's carry bundle and newly completed row artifacts, consolidates every valid completed row into a new carry bundle, and schedules only rows absent from that validated bundle. Thus one immediate predecessor run carries the validated union of all earlier generations.
carry_over.validation: Reuse only a complete canonical row certificate whose producer/worker blobs, shard index/count, deterministic row assignment, assignment digest, completion status and no-credit firewalls validate under the current source-locked worker.
carry_over.missing_or_rejected: Only missing or rejected row units enter the heavy matrix. Valid carried rows do not receive a compute job.
carry_over.partial_container_salvage: A cancelled/failed prior workflow may still contribute every row artifact that completed before cancellation; no workflow-level success is inferred or required.

cancellation_recovery.row_completion: A row is durable only after exact certificate validation, then its compact certificate is uploaded immediately as hpadj20-row-<unit> with if: always().
cancellation_recovery.timeout_or_cancel: Increment the runkey generation, set carry_run_id to the failed/cancelled run, validate that run's inherited carry bundle plus completed row artifacts, and schedule only the remaining rows.
cancellation_recovery.running_partial_row: Discard an interrupted row unless a complete certificate passes the same exact validation; file existence alone is not completion.

union_verification.rule: Final aggregation requires exactly 178 source-locked row certificates, reconstructs the deterministic partition, rejects gaps/overlaps/source drift, sums exact Fraction objectives and cellwise integer floors, reconstructs diagnostic order, and reasserts all HPADJ20 <= HPADJ19/benchmark conditions.

concurrency_preflight.reference_precedent: Stage32-18T capped effective heavy concurrency at 15 to preserve cross-Stage and audit headroom.
concurrency_preflight.overlap_rule: The 15 is this HPADJ20 matrix contribution. Before arming, other simultaneously runnable Stage32 heavy workloads must be counted; if their overlap could push Stage32 above 18, do not arm or reduce this workflow further.
concurrency_preflight.arm_time_observation: User cancelled all live workflows before this rebuild; no other intended Stage32 heavy production run is being deliberately co-launched with this generation.
concurrency_preflight.stop_condition: Cancel/stop if actual Stage32 heavy overlap can exceed 18.

storage_preflight.projection_basis: One complete predecessor generation of up to 178 one-MiB row artifacts + one current generation of up to 178 one-MiB row artifacts + <=12 MiB carry bundle + <=2 MB final union + <=1 MB recovery snapshot.
storage_preflight.stop_condition: Fail closed before/at upload if any row certificate exceeds 65,536 raw bytes, if bundle/final bounds are exceeded, or if the 500 MB projected storage budget is no longer safe.

authorization.method: Fresh commit-range dedicated runkey generation gate before heavy compute.
authorization.workflow_concurrency_group: One HPADJ20 heavy generation per PR; cancel-in-progress=false so a newer synchronization cannot silently destroy durable work.
